manual_scope_findings.finding: original_file reads complete regular files only under its explicit byte limit, records exact content SHA and expected-match booleans, compares before/after metadata, and records full-content reads for a final identity pass. No source is executed.

The only subprocess invocation is finite git -C PATH rev-parse --show-toplevel or HEAD, timeout15 and GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. No Lean, Lake, guard, action, build, export or git mutation command is invoked.

Resources are observations: host MemAvailable, disk, CPU affinity and namespace/mountinfo. Script explicitly disclaims future two-thread allocation, hard cgroup reservation and OOM guarantee; it does not infer environment headroom from host cache.

The only newly inspected compiler-module content is five exact Lake.Util.Casing facets, all already supplied by the fixed accepted delta. Missing/oversize/mismatching cases are recorded, not silently accepted as matches.

Eighteen already received objects and six associated sources are metadata-only. Recorded hashes are not recomputed from their contents. The exact exclusive receiving root is enforced for the supplied paths.

Configuration reads are limited to four named config files under each of two fixed roots; runtime/guard/action candidates have finite fixed dictionaries. Original shape search roots are stat-only; package git metadata follows those named roots. Action script content is inspected only if its original git commit matches.
Every fully read file gets a final metadata equality check. Success status means bounded metadata capture only, explicitly not a new import or proof qualification.

Exceptions emit a bounded failure record with partial captured results, or an explicit full_result_not_emitted summary if the budget is exceeded, then re-raise for nonzero exit. Source is not written, and no failed prerequisite is turned into proof acceptance.

nonblocking_limits_to_preserve: Expected content hashes/sizes and received-object stat equality are reported booleans, not this task's acceptance gate. A captured result with false booleans must not later be treated as input qualification.

Metadata-only eighteen-object/source observations are point-in-time checks; the final READ_IDENTITIES pass covers complete content reads, not those metadata-only observations. Later actual-import receiving must perform its own current binding.
Resource measurements do not reserve memory/CPU or qualify a future compilation. The literal service-enforcement description is an observation basis, not a fresh service-contract sample.
The stdout limit is 1800000 bytes for the JSON result. Oversized combined results or read/permission/timeouts can fail, with an explicit failure receipt; no automatic resubmission is prescribed.
No complete compiled-header graph is produced; source imports and the old native515 summary are not used as substitutes.
Final production request/result have not been run or observed by this reviewer; no runtime pass is asserted.
permission_scope: Static review only. Root/Atlas retain sole task submission and later actual result acceptance.
